adjudication.rationale: In `Jobs::PollFeed#execute`, `poll_feed` is only called when all three conditions are true: `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled? && SiteSetting.feed_polling_url.present? && SiteSetting.embed_by_username.present?` (see `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`). In `spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb`, the example `it "requires feed_polling_url"` stubs only `feed_polling_url` to `nil` and does not stub `feed_polling_enabled?` to `true` (nor `embed_by_username` to present). Since `feed_polling_enabled` defaults to `false` in `config/site_settings.yml`, this spec will pass due to the first condition failing even if the `feed_polling_url.present?` guard were removed, so it doesn’t actually verify the URL guard. This is a real, diff-grounded test coverage gap, not a production defect.
